entities.name: Niccolò d’Acciapaccio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolò Acciapacci (1383–1447) was a Neapolitan bishop and cardinal. An ally of Francesco Sforza, he spent his last years in exile from Rome, but was considered a candidate for the papacy in 1447.
